model.name: qwen3.8-27b
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.8, 27B dense, FP8 as published by Qwen. Thinking mode off, so it answers directly like gpt-oss at low reasoning effort. Apache-2.0. A hybrid (linear-attention) model: vLLM's default of 256 sequences exceeds its state cache on a 48 GB card, hence --max-num-seqs 64.

answers.sql:
SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(t.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c
    ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS active_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND dt.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    AVG(rt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON rt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy
  ON rt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    m.MKT_ID AS market_id,
    SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D v
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON v.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MKT_ID
ORDER BY m.MKT_ID;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
),
active_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM all_customers c
WHERE c.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM active_2025);

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        a.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS declined_pct
FROM auth_2025;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
JOIN target_date t ON d.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(r.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
    ON r.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE t.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
        ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_txn_cnt,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC) AS rnk
    FROM txn_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY region_code, branch_name;

WITH trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    t.total_amt
FROM trf_2025 t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY t.total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON t.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON at.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm_2025 a
JOIN wr_2025 w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    ddt.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt
  ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY ddt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY ddt.CAL_YR_NBR;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(wt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy
    ON wt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(t.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c
    ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS active_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND dt.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    AVG(r.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON r.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
    m.MKT_ID AS market_id,
    SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D v
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON v.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MKT_ID
ORDER BY m.MKT_ID;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1,
    COUNT(*) AS ACCT_CNT
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
),
active_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM all_customers c
WHERE c.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM active_2025);

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        a.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS declined_pct
FROM auth_2025;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE t.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME';

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, br.BR_K ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
        ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        br.RGN_CD1,
        br.DSPLY_NM,
        br.BR_K
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_cnt
FROM branch_txn_counts
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    t.total_amt
FROM trf_2025 t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY t.total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON t.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON at.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm_2025 a
JOIN wr_2025 w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    ddt.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt
  ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY ddt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY ddt.CAL_YR_NBR;

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(wt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy
  ON wt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(t.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c
    ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS active_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND dt.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    AVG(fxrt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fxrt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON fxrt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy
  ON fxrt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
    m.MKT_ID AS market_id,
    SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D v
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON v.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MKT_ID
ORDER BY m.MKT_ID;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.ACCT_NBR_HSH) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
),
active_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM all_customers c
WHERE c.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM active_2025);

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        fa.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
      ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS declined_pct
FROM auth_2025;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(r.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
    ON r.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_cross_border_wire_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE t.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
        ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_txn_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_name ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM txn_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    t.total_amt
FROM trf_2025 t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY t.total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON t.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON at.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm_2025 a
JOIN wr_2025 w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(wt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy
    ON wt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.CCY_CD1;
